0022600157.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-1, third in the Atlantic and fourth in the East, on a W1 streak) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (4-1, first in the Pacific and third in the West, also on a W1 streak). Toronto is out Kawhi Leonard (knee, inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot, fracture), while Los Angeles is out Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot). The Raptors lost the 2025-26 season series 0-2, including a 110-93 loss in Los Angeles on January 18, and the teams have not yet played each other in the 2026-27 season.
